scope: Independent read-only review of actual plan_only trial source, not live/target verification
specialization_gate: Only shared==NULL and hw exactly1/2/4 select partial builder. shared remains authoritative; hw0 and all other hw keep original full builder.

ON_base_safety.reason: Generic root adds only active phases, and chooses hwbit?q:base. An ON phase is active but always selects q, so its partial-plan base is not a source-level read. Both OFF bases are assigned every helper call, includingq0.
ON_base_safety.off_active: ON bits may remain absent; active=hw|(off_active&~hw) reinstates them.
ON_base_safety.tail_fields: point/phase are read only whenk<count; terminal segment usescu. sort readsindex1 only ifcount==2.
ON_base_safety.cross_hw_reuse: A partial plan must not be reused as a shared plan for another hw. Actual seed/shared plans still come from unchanged full builder. Later NULL calls rebuild both relevant OFF fields, and hw0 NULL rebuilds all phases.

math_and_FP_checks: cu/cl/span/full-three-phase scale expression and finite tests/tolerance match original builder verbatim
q<0/q>=0 initial active conditions and strict q!=0 interior filtering unchanged; no sign-only shortcut

failure_contract: Private plan/workspace ONbase and unusedtail contents may differ; they are not public outputs and are never consumed for a different hardware mask in the actual path. No exemption for raw root failed status/next bytes is introduced. Shared input must remain unchanged. Public failed PC_Output retains its documented basic/status/safe-gate validity contract.
